summary:
Implemented a front-door iPhone resume upgrade across Home, Drive Map, and Search.

Home Resume Work now shows active shortcuts for current local work like live roadside, diagnostic call/checks, and Drive Map snapshots. Drive Map now stores the latest GPS snapshot locally, and Global Search Recent Work sorts by freshness so a fresh location snapshot can appear before older roadside or diagnostic work. Home Copy Latest also now exposes a manual-copy fallback when clipboard access is blocked. Bumped PWA cache to `ridgeline-console-v447`.

Verified:
`node --check agent-status.js shared-ui.js drive-map.js service-worker.js`
`Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
`git diff --check` passed with only LF-to-CRLF warnings.
Direct Edge/Playwright iPhone probes passed for Home active shortcuts/manual fallback and Search freshness ordering. `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1` timed out, so I used narrower direct probes.

Next slice: fix or replace the hanging browser smoke wrapper, then use it to verify Ask Anton and shared iPhone route bars.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Home and Search now let an iPhone user jump back into live roadside, diagnostics, or the latest Drive Map snapshot from the front door.
Impact Reason: It reduces taps during active truck situations and makes locally saved work recoverable even when iOS blocks clipboard copy.
Ended Early Because: Stopped at a clean point after three related visible slices; broader changes would be risky while the main smoke wrapper is timing out.
Time Lost To: `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1` timeouts on `index.html`.
